run_finetune_ldm_decoder: run the CLI to fine-tune a Stable Diffusion decoder for embedding watermarks into images
run_train_function: run the train function to optimize the LDM decoder with watermark and image reconstruction losses
run_val_function: run the val function to evaluate watermark robustness against attacks like cropping, rotation, and JPEG compression
review_get_parser: review the get_parser function to understand data, model, training, and logging argument groups
review_main: review the main function to understand the full pipeline of loading models, whitening, training, and saving checkpoints
